result.question: What does the old prophet say to the man of God?

readings.answer: Come home with me and eat some bread.
readings.support: Come home with me and eat some bread.

readings.answer: Are you the man of God who came from Judah?
readings.support: Are you the man of God who came from Judah?

assessments.reason: Verse 13:15 has the prophet say to the man of God, “Come home with me and eat some bread,” which is the same request as the key’s “Come home and eat food,” with acceptable paraphrase (bread = food, added “with me” is fine).

Verse 13:14 shows the prophet speaking to the man of God: “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?” This is indeed something the (old) prophet says to the man of God, so it fits the question’s wording even though it differs from the keyed line.

result.reason: The prophet says two different things to the man of God in the window, so more than one materially different answer fits the question.
